verdict.rationale: CrewAI is itself an official, open-source Python framework that you build against in code. The docs show direct class usage such as `Crew(agents=..., tasks=..., process=Process.sequential)` and a single `Memory` class API, and the framework installs via `uv tool install crewai` from the official GitHub repo. Deployed crews are also exposed through documented REST endpoints (kickoff/status/resume). Missing for 10: official SDKs in languages beyond Python, an official client SDK or machine-readable OpenAPI spec for the AMP REST API (the openapi probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
